intervals.label: collaboration
intervals.note: Start taken as the January 2002 start of data taking, as a lower bound; the true formation date is not sourced. Other KamLAND sources give 21 January (arXiv:hep-ex/0405001) and March 2002 (arXiv:2606.29381) for the start of operation.
intervals.quote: In January 22, 2002, KamLAND started the data-taking.

name: KamLAND Collaboration
notes: No membership counts (scientists/institutions/countries) were found in any source consulted (checked 2026-09-17); the official site's technical/member pages returned 404 on every URL tried. Left null rather than guessed.
Led by the Research Center for Neutrino Science, Tohoku University, per the official homepage; a formal institution list was not reachable (checked 2026-09-17).

summary.plain: The team of scientists, based at Tohoku University's Research Center for Neutrino Science, who built and run the KamLAND experiment in Japan.
summary.technical: Collaboration operating KamLAND, led by the Research Center for Neutrino Science, Tohoku University; membership counts not found in the sources consulted.
